variables.physical_definition: Side length of the square duct (characteristic length scale of the flow)
Dynamic viscosity of the fluid (momentum diffusivity times density)
Electrical resistivity of the fluid (electrical resistance per unit length)
Applied pressure gradient along the flow direction (pressure change per unit length)
Magnitude of the applied magnetic field
